notes: «قال زهير حدثنا جرير» repeats Jarir in Zuhayr's own line: one link (rule 7).

Unsettled (rule 6): «كنا عند حذيفة» may be a place, or Hudhayfa may be the last link, since his speech and first-person account follow («فقال حذيفة»; «فلما وليت»). Hudhayfa is not added; the ruling decides whether the father is the last link.
